1.web: Listen to my prayer, God. Don’t hide yourself from my supplication.
1.asv: Give ear to my prayer, O God; And hide not thyself from my supplication.

2.web: Attend to me, and answer me. I am restless in my complaint, and moan,
2.asv: Attend unto me, and answer me: I am restless in my complaint, and moan,

3.web: Because of the voice of the enemy, Because of the oppression of the wicked. For they bring suffering on me. In anger they hold a grudge against me.
3.asv: Because of the voice of the enemy, Because of the oppression of the wicked; For they cast iniquity upon me, And in anger they persecute me.

4.web: My heart is severely pained within me. The terrors of death have fallen on me.
4.asv: My heart is sore pained within me: And the terrors of death are fallen upon me.

5.web: Fearfulness and trembling have come on me. Horror has overwhelmed me.
5.asv: Fearfulness and trembling are come upon me, And horror hath overwhelmed me.

6.web: I said, “Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then I would fly away, and be at rest.
6.asv: And I said, Oh that I had wings like a dove! Then would I fly away, and be at rest.

7.web: Behold, then I would wander far off. I would lodge in the wilderness.” Selah.
7.asv: Lo, then would I wander far off, I would lodge in the wilderness. [Selah

8.web: “I would hurry to a shelter from the stormy wind and storm.”
8.asv: I would haste me to a shelter From the stormy wind and tempest.

9.web: Confuse them, Lord, and confound their language, for I have seen violence and strife in the city.
9.asv: Destroy, O Lord, and divide their tongue; For I have seen violence and strife in the city.

10.web: Day and night they prowl around on its walls. Malice and abuse are also within her.
10.asv: Day and night they go about it upon the walls thereof: Iniquity also and mischief are in the midst of it.

11.web: Destructive forces are within her. Threats and lies don’t depart from her streets.
11.asv: Wickedness is in the midst thereof: Oppression and guile depart not from its streets.

12.web: For it was not an enemy who insulted me, then I could have endured it. Neither was it he who hated me who raised himself up against me, then I would have hidden myself from him.
12.asv: For it was not an enemy that reproached me; Then I could have borne it: Neither was it he that hated me that did magnify himself against me; Then I would have hid myself from him:

13.web: But it was you, a man like me, my companion, and my familiar friend.
13.asv: But it was thou, a man mine equal, My companion, and my familiar friend.

14.web: We took sweet fellowship together. We walked in God’s house with company.
14.asv: We took sweet counsel together; We walked in the house of God with the throng.

15.web: Let death come suddenly on them. Let them go down alive into Sheol. For wickedness is in their dwelling, in their midst.
15.asv: Let death come suddenly upon them, Let them go down alive into Sheol; For wickedness is in their dwelling, in the midst of them.

16.web: As for me, I will call on God. Yahweh will save me.
16.asv: As for me, I will call upon God; And Jehovah will save me.

17.web: Evening, morning, and at noon, I will cry out in distress. He will hear my voice.
17.asv: Evening, and morning, and at noonday, will I complain, and moan; And he will hear my voice.

18.web: He has redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me, although there are many who oppose me.
18.asv: He hath redeemed my soul in peace from the battle that was against me; For they were many that strove with me.

19.web: God, who is enthroned forever, will hear, and answer them. Selah. They never change, who don’t fear God.
19.asv: God will hear, and answer them, Even he that abideth of old, [Selah The menwho have no changes, And who fear not God.

20.web: He raises his hands against his friends. He has violated his covenant.
20.asv: He hath put forth his hands against such as were at peace with him: He hath profaned his covenant.

21.web: His mouth was smooth as butter, but his heart was war. His words were softer than oil, yet they were drawn swords.
21.asv: His mouth was smooth as butter, But his heart was war: His words were softer than oil, Yet were they drawn swords.

22.web: Cast your burden on Yahweh, and he will sustain you. He will never allow the righteous to be moved.
22.asv: Cast thy burden upon Jehovah, and he will sustain thee: He will never suffer the righteous to be moved.

23.web: But you, God, will bring them down into the pit of destruction. Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days, but I will trust in you.
23.asv: But thou, O God, wilt bring them down into the pit of destruction: Bloodthirsty and deceitful men shall not live out half their days; But I will trust in thee.
